name: Journal of a Saint
source:
The main character is Roy (you can change the name). The plot revolves around his infatuation with his new stepmother, Penny. While staying at April's house, graciously offered after unfortunate events, players will seek ways to capture Penny's attention and win her affection. April will be 24 years old, remembering that in "The Lécuyer Cult" she is 31. This story focuses on her childhood and adolescence, serving as a prequel to "The Lécuyer Cult".​

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/download-all-my-148815117]Patreon[/url]]
